tests, internal tests aligned to its own profile, and reverse stress tests identifying circumstances under which the business model would
become unviable. Reverse stress testing results are reported to the Board annually and inform the Recovery Plan. Assumptions and the
sensitivity of results to them are disclosed alongside results; a stress result presented without its assumptions is not a valid report.

of each exercise and reports to the Board Risk Committee where results have not been acted upon.
